## Services

- Video editing and short-form cuts for supplied footage.
- AI-assisted images, motion, and creative variations.
- Social media planning and monthly content strategy.
- Phone-based capture for social media and small on-location projects.
- Product photography by project.
- Aerial options only after pilot availability, airspace, weather, property permission, and required authorization are confirmed.

## Service Areas

- Fort Lauderdale is the operating base.
- Broward County and Miami are the normal local markets.
- Palm Beach County is an expansion area; Boca Raton and other listed cities are considered by quote.
- A travel fee may apply beyond 20 miles from Fort Lauderdale, and required parking is added to the quote.
- Remote editing, AI-assisted content, and social planning do not require an on-location visit.

## Working Terms

- Esteban Moreno Media is a remote-first service-area business with no client-facing studio.
- On-location work is ideally booked three to four days ahead.
- Delivery timing is confirmed after the project is reviewed; urgent requests depend on workload.
- Two review rounds are normally included. Additional revisions are quoted separately.

## Proof Policy

The bilingual portfolio presents a curated selection of Esteban's published work with public YouTube sources and project credits when available. The site should only publish real Esteban work, real public media links, real testimonials, and real client examples. No fake testimonials, borrowed client logos, or guaranteed views/rankings.
